welcome.step1: Open or confirm your TradeQuo account

instructions.heading: Open your TradeQuo account
instructions.intro: EZ Trade requires a TradeQuo account opened under our IB. Use the link below. It's pre-filled with the right code.
instructions.referredByBody: The link below opens a TradeQuo account under their sub-IB.
instructions.nextStep1: Complete TradeQuo's signup and KYC. Standard documents. Passport, utility bill. Approval typically within a few hours on business days.
instructions.nextStep2: Open at least one MT4 or MT5 account in the TradeQuo dashboard. Note your account number and server.
instructions.nextStep3: Fund the account. $250+ reaches Bronze status.
instructions.nextStep4: Come back, click the button below, and we'll match your account against our IB records.
instructions.transferTitle: Already have a TradeQuo account but under a different IB?

brokerForm.heading: Connect your broker
brokerForm.intro: Enter your details exactly as they appear in your broker portal. Mismatches delay verification.
brokerForm.uidHelp: Found in your broker's IB portal.
brokerForm.accountEmailHelp: The email on your broker account.
brokerForm.mtServerHelp: Exact string as shown in your MT4/5 login screen.
brokerForm.mtLoginHelp: The numeric login of your MT4/5 account.
brokerForm.mt5PasswordHelp: The MT5 password is read-only. Not your trading password. EZ Trade cannot place trades with it.
brokerForm.telegramHelp: Required. We add you to the trader chat group.
brokerForm.agree: I confirm these details belong to my account, opened under EZ Trade’s IB.
